name: Debt Management
overview: Scripture teaches that wise financial stewardship includes careful management of debt, recognizing that borrowing places one in a position of servitude to the lender, as Proverbs 22:7 highlights. A godly person aims to leave a lasting inheritance for future generations, demonstrating responsible wealth management rather than accumulating debt. Ultimately, believers are called to prioritize seeking God's kingdom and righteousness, trusting that He will provide for their needs, which undergirds faithful and prudent debt management.
